classification: Exposed synthetic development cases; not held-out evaluation

qualified_review.note: AI-generated expectations; no qualified linguistic approval. Review meanings, permissible uncertainty and normalizations before inference.

policy: Permitted safe uncertainty is not a successful interpretation or proof of support. Structural validation and machine state checks cannot establish semantic fidelity. No language/country preference resolves meaning.

cases.expected_meaning: Clearly unsupported input: unsupported/null hypothesis, explicit limitation and DE/FR/IT/EN rephrasing. No forced English recognition or search record.

cases.text: Ich möchte mein Fahrrad reparieren, ohne es zu ersetzen.
cases.expected_meaning: DE; bicycle subject, repair action, no replacement constraint with correct scope and negation.

cases.text: Je veux réparer mon vélo sans le remplacer.
cases.expected_meaning: FR; bicycle subject, repair action, no replacement constraint with correct scope and negation.

cases.text: Vorrei riparare la mia bicicletta senza sostituirla.
cases.expected_meaning: IT; bicycle subject, repair action, no replacement constraint with correct scope and negation.

cases.text: I want to repair my bicycle without replacing it.
cases.expected_meaning: EN; bicycle subject, repair action, no replacement constraint. Synthetic CH comparison may save only after complete English preparation.

cases.text: Réparer le vélo Acme X-2 à Genève, sans le remplacer; budget 49,90 CHF pour une réparation.
cases.expected_meaning: FR; bicycle repair; literal Acme X-2 and Genève; textual locality requirement; no replacement; exact 49.90 CHF budget per repair/once, no fabricated baseline or inclusive price.

cases.text: Please repair my bicycle, sans remplacement
cases.expected_meaning: Mixed EN/FR, clear EN primary if established; bicycle repair without replacement. Complete meaning must retain French constraint. If actually unresolved ask about that clause, or explain unavailable capability. Uncertainty is a recorded suitability gap, never a passing complete interpretation.

Balanced DE/EN/FR; bicycle repair with no replacement. Mixed/null primary is acceptable when fully understood, then explanation preference/one-time choice. Unresolved meaning clarifies before preference. No majority-language constraint loss.

Meaning ambiguity: can denote bicycle in Swiss German or veil in Italian. Ask which subject is intended. No forced bicycle, invented action or language detection; browser/preference/country cannot resolve it. Architecture example is conditional on already understood bicycle meaning.

cases.text: Repair my bicycle; budget 1,200 CHF per repair.
cases.expected_meaning: EN language can be clear while amount is ambiguous. Preserve number 1,200 and CHF/per repair; do not choose 1.200 versus 1200. Either targeted needs_clarification or an understood packet retaining amount null routes to amount clarification. No saved search.

cases.text: Repair my bicycle without changing the thing I mentioned.
cases.expected_meaning: Unresolved referent/scope: preserve repair and the negated condition; ask which thing or explain capability limitation. Never assume a replacement constraint.

Swiss dialect support is not promised. Limitation/rephrasing or targeted clarification is acceptable. If claiming understanding, preserve bicycle repair and not-new/no replacement intent and negation; a standard-DE label alone proves neither. Qualified dialect review is required for that claim.

cases.text: Repair my Quillora kettle and my bicycle without replacing either.
cases.expected_meaning: EN; novel literal Quillora, kettle and bicycle joint subjects, repair both, no replacement of either; no forced single subject or inferred catalogue support.

cases.text: Find a cheaper waterproof jacket under 0.5 kg; keep waterproofing, budget 80.00 EUR per jacket.
cases.expected_meaning: EN; jacket, cheaper goal with no invented current-cost baseline, waterproofing retained, strictly under 0.5 kg, exact 80.00 EUR budget per jacket/once, no conversion or inclusive-price assumption.
